summary: Reviewed the E-GO AppIR capability and analyzer changes against the frozen compiler contract; identified the empty-string Arg inference mismatch; decision amend.

finding.detail: A typed keyed lifecycle.cancel descriptor with Arg:"" does not add effect.cancel, while the identical parenthesized Arg:("") does. The frozen rule requires a string-typed Arg expression; token validity is a runtime policy concern. This can bypass mount-time host admission for an Update that emits lifecycle.cancel.
finding.reproduction: Update returns []gobi.Effect{{Kind:"lifecycle.cancel",Name:"cancel",Arg:"",Reply:""}}; changing only Arg to ("") flips effect.cancel inference.
finding.requested_repair: Remove the nonempty literal condition and test both direct and parenthesized empty string forms; retain exact type, keyed descriptor, Update reachability, and protocol field checks.
